finding.expected: Bind the exact RUN path owned by each PRIMARY and REPAIR invocation at RUN creation and use only that bound path for post-admission FAILURE and RUN_OBSERVATION persistence. Foreign RUN creation must neither suppress nor steal the current invocation's terminal operational state. Add deterministic regression tests for PRIMARY and REPAIR race interleavings without widening TASK-046 semantics or changing canonical contracts.
finding.issue: PRIMARY and REPAIR failure wrappers still infer ownership of the current invocation's RUN by snapshotting the global runs directory before execution and diffing it after the inner repository lock has unwound. Another process can create a foreign RUN in that gap, causing the current post-admission failure/observation to be suppressed when multiple new files are seen, or a pre-RUN failure to claim a foreign RUN when it is the only new file. This is the same ownership class already eliminated for REMEDIATION by binding an invocation-local run_path.
